name: Fermat's little theorem
formula: p \text{ prime},\ p \nmid a \implies a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod p
whenToUse: Find the remainder of a huge power when divided by a prime. Reduce the exponent modulo $p - 1$.
pitfall: The modulus must be prime and must not divide the base. The exponent reduces modulo $p - 1$, not modulo $p$.
